intro.title: Parking Active Bills with F6
intro.subtitle: Unblock the counter when a patient steps away to fetch cash

narration.text: Welcome to MediFlow Quick Guides. In this video, you will learn how to park an active bill using shortcut F6.
When a customer steps away to fetch cash from an ATM, don't cancel their bill. Press F6 to park their cart.
Add a quick reference note, such as 'Customer stepped out for cash', and confirm.
The counter clears immediately, ready to serve the next patient in line without locking stock.
Your parked bill is safely stored in the queue. To continue this workflow, watch Part 8 to see how to resume parked bills using F7.

outro.takeaway: Parked bills lock zero inventory and allocate no invoice numbers.
